about.page_sub: We are a passionate team of developers building digital products that help businesses grow faster.
about.mission_text: To make professional web applications accessible to every business in Bangladesh and beyond — ready to launch, built to scale.
about.vision_text: A world where any entrepreneur can have a production-grade digital product within days, not months — at a fraction of the cost.
about.story_text: Founded by a team of full-stack developers, we noticed that most businesses needed the same core functionality over and over. So we built a library of production-ready web apps — polished, documented, and ready to ship. Today we serve clients across Bangladesh and internationally, delivering fast, modern, and reliable digital products.

about.value_4_desc: We optimize for launch velocity without sacrificing quality or maintainability.

privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.

privacy.s1_li1: Name, email address, and phone number when you register.
privacy.s1_li2: Messages you send via our contact form or custom project request form.
privacy.s1_li3: Pages visited, browser type, and IP address collected automatically via server logs.

privacy.s3_p2: While we take reasonable measures to protect your information, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.s4_p1: We use session cookies to maintain your login state and language preference. No third-party advertising or tracking cookies are used on this website. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect site functionality.
